description: Pull observations for a Bundesbank series as SDMX-JSON. flowRef is the dataflow id (e.g. "BBEX3"); key is a dot-separated SDMX dimension filter in key order (e.g. "D.USD.EUR.BB.AC.000" = daily USD/EUR reference rate). Use dataflow_structure to discover the dimensions/codes for a flow. Leave a dimension empty to wildcard it (e.g. "D..EUR.BB.AC.000"). Filter by lastNObservations (most recent N) or a startPeriod/endPeriod date range (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

endPeriod.description: Inclusive end period (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

key.description: Dot-separated SDMX dimension filter, e.g. "D.USD.EUR.BB.AC.000". Empty segments wildcard a dimension.

lastNObservations.description: Return only the most recent N observations.

startPeriod.description: Inclusive start period (YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD).

name: get_series
title: Get Series
